speechBackend: Real recorded narration and Web Audio mixing through ordinary UI controls. This tests playback and captions, not human listening quality.
checks: Speech start exposes exact captions, hides the overlapping compact heading and ducks the real music bus
Skip clears captions and restores music without leaving a canceled speech callback active
Result narration matches the visible explanation and moving to the next exercise cancels it
Mute cancels active speech and captions immediately
